# Fastino Labs

> Build structured decisions with GLiDE, run schema-based extraction with GLiNER, and fine-tune specialized models with Fastino.

> ## Agent instructions
> Use https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json as the source of truth for customer-facing routes. For GLiDE decision inference, call `POST https://api.fastino.ai/v1/systemone` with model `fastino/GLiDE`. Do not infer undocumented routes. Read API keys from `FASTINO_API_KEY` and never embed credentials in code, logs, or reports.

## Agent resources

- [OpenAPI specification](https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json): Read the canonical customer-facing routes, authentication requirements, and request and response schemas.
- [Agent Skills catalog](https://docs.fastino.ai/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Discover installable skills for datasets, fine-tuning, GLiDE, GLiNER, and inference.

## Get started

- [Fastino GLiDE agent skill](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-agent-skill.md): Install GLiDE instructions for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex.
- [Introduction](https://docs.fastino.ai/introduction.md): Learn how Fastino provides training and inference for specialized models.
- [Fastino quickstart](https://docs.fastino.ai/quickstart.md): Create a Fastino API key and run your first inference or training request.
- [Example Use Cases](https://docs.fastino.ai/example-use-cases.md): Explore concrete GLiDE applications across agents, operations, safety, research, and product workflows.

## Decision Models

- [GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide.md): Understand when to use Fastino's decision model for classification, routing, and scoring.
- [GLiDE reference](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/decision-models.md): Read the request contract, state shapes, confidence formulas, and multi-question example.
- [Noul](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-noul.md): Ask a yes/no question and receive the probability that the answer is true.
- [Choice](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-choice.md): Select one caller-defined option and receive its probability distribution.
- [Score](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-score.md): Select a level on an ordered rubric and receive a discrete score plus expected level.
- [Route requests with GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/guides/glide-routing.md): Build a request router, inspect route probabilities, and send uncertain decisions to a fallback.
- [Score on an ordered rubric with GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/guides/glide-scoring.md): Consume both discrete and continuous results from an ordered scoring rubric.
- [Rerank retrieved passages with GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/guides/glide-reranking.md): Score query-to-passage relevance, filter weak matches, and rerank retrieved context.
- [GLiDE inference](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference/systemone.md): Call `POST /v1/systemone` with a shared `state` and typed `questions`; receive calibrated answers without generated text.

## Inference API

- [Inference overview](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference.md): Choose between GLiDE decision inference and GLiNER extraction.
- [Chat Completions](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference/chat-completions.md): Run GLiNER entity extraction, classification, structured extraction, and relations through `POST /v1/chat/completions`.

## Training API

- [Fastino GLiNER agent skill](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner-agent-skill.md): Install Fastino's hosted GLiNER skill for your coding agent.
- [Training API](https://docs.fastino.ai/training.md): Create and manage Fastino training jobs from submission through artifact delivery.
- [Create a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/create.md): Submit a new model training job.
- [List training jobs](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/list.md): List training jobs available to the current account.
- [Get a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/get.md): Retrieve the current state and metadata for one training job.
- [Update a training job's project](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/update-project.md): Assign a training job to a different project.
- [Rename a trained model](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/update-model-name.md): Change the model name associated with a training job.
- [Get training logs](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/logs.md): Read training output logs.
- [Get training-job billing](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/billing.md): Review billing information for a training job.
- [Stop a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/stop.md): Request a graceful stop.
- [Terminate a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/terminate.md): Terminate a running job.
- [List training checkpoints](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/checkpoints.md): List checkpoints produced by a training job.
- [Deploy a training checkpoint](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/deploy-checkpoint.md): Deploy a selected checkpoint for inference.
- [Download trained weights](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/download.md): Download a trained model artifact.
- [Delete a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/delete.md): Delete a training job and its associated records.

## Models

- [GLiNER-2.5-Decide](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner-2-5-decide.md): Use classification-tuned GLiNER for intent, routing, priority, moderation, and other operational labels.
- [GLiNER2.5](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner.md): Use multilingual, schema-driven information extraction.
- [Model catalog](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/models.md): Browse canonical model IDs, parameters, context windows, and per-model inference pricing.
- Query `GET https://api.fastino.ai/v1/base-models` for current model availability and pricing.

## Account

- [Pricing](https://docs.fastino.ai/pricing.md): Review inference and training pricing.
- [Trust and safety](https://docs.fastino.ai/trust-safety.md): Learn how Fastino protects data and secures its infrastructure.
